observations.explanation: The benchmark spans four configurable categories and varies sequence length and task complexity (PDF p. 3). Appendix C reports a task-correlation study used to select 13 representative tasks (PDF p. 16).
The paper reports near-perfect performance on passkey retrieval and vanilla NIAH but degradation in the 13-task average as length increases (PDF pp. 6–7; Appendix E, PDF p. 21).

RULER is explicitly described as solely synthetic, and the paper calls aggregation tasks proxies for summarization; QA is an adaptation of existing datasets (PDF pp. 2, 5). The qualification that these results alone do not establish realistic long-document understanding is appropriately scoped.

Effective length is defined using Llama2-7B’s 4K score as a fixed threshold (PDF p. 6). The paper reports results under that rule but does not test robustness to alternative thresholds or baselines, so this is a qualified open question rather than a demonstrated defect (PDF pp. 6, 14).
